facts.business: Lovable Lingerie Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of women's innerwear and apparel products across domestic markets through retail chains, multi-brand outlets, exclusive brand outlets, e-commerce marketplaces, and wholesale distributors.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets including capital advances

key_risks: Competitive intensity from major international apparel brands operating in India
Complexity in revenue measurement due to varied contractual terms across diversified customer base
Dependence on domestic market with low per-capita consumption
facts.related_party_note: Inter-corporate deposits (net) of Rs. 13.50 lakhs in FY 2025-26 and Rs. 6.75 lakhs in FY 2024-25
